title: cistus albidus f. albus
intro: Cistus albidus f. albus, commonly known as White Rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the genus Cistus. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and skin issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cistus albidus f. albus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its ability to soothe skin irritations and calm the mind. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
